TWO SEPARATE MOVEMENTS, stated apart because the previous floor entry was left ambiguous about exactly this.

(1) PRE-EXISTING DRIFT, NOT THIS SERIES': mainline measured 2158 against the committed floor of 2134, i.e. the gate was ALREADY RED BY +24 before any of this work. No .js/.ts had been touched by the series when that was measured. That +24 is absorbed here only because leaving the floor at 2134 keeps CI red for everyone; the same precedent as the 07-30 entry.

(2) THIS SERIES IS -17 ON TOP OF THAT. Three root causes, no suppressions and no new exceptions:
  * services.d.ts was stale and imported @web/components/datetime/datetime_picker_service, a module that does not exist; allowedQwebExpressionsService likewise came from a file that no longer exports it. Regenerating it exposed 16 errors that had been hiding behind an unresolved import degrading to any.
  * Those 16 were one bug: datetime_picker_service.js both imports a component class named DateTimePicker and declares a @typedef of the same name. The value import wins, so picker.state resolved to the component's internal state instead of DateTimePickerProps. tsc had already been reporting the collision as TS2440. Renaming the typedef to DateTimePickerHandle fixed 11 of the 16 plus 2 pre-existing.
  * fieldDependencies entries were typed as Partial<StaticWidgetInfo> — a widget type for what are field descriptors — so each field key had to be bolted onto the widget interface individually. 'written' was missing and week_days.js declares it on all seven of its dependencies. Introduced a FieldDependency interface mirroring FIELD_DEPENDENCIES_VALIDATION.

Both per-file locks (strict, noImplicitAny) now report ZERO regressed files over addons/web/static/{src,tests}; neither exception list grew. 6355 web tests pass.
